conclusions.current_assessment: 按2026-10-16用户指令并列评估fixed与scClassify P/N F1，突出任一口径的收益与分歧；Purity仅辅助。冻结程序gate原样保留。
conclusions.B0: 每项BASE_MATCH相关比较均加入B0，可作论文历史主参照；同时保留BASE_MATCH匹配机制对照。B0训练历史不配对；明显F1差值伴随约12pp capture损失，不能全部归因于新模块。
conclusions.A1: 88102/107955配对细胞，Core对Type及20个shuffle都有条件信息增量，GO_A2；不是mask/F1端点，不证明真实核外owner正确性。
conclusions.A2: GTC相对GT及SHUFFLED在两套P/N F1都更差，未建立当前cell-specific Core评分增量。GT相对native两套F1明确改善，但局部RNA保留损失未解决。
conclusions.minimal_tested_candidate: BASE native + 在本次A1 Core可用/适用类型/合法donor共同域内的固定G+T修正。它的评分不使用cell-specific q，但域仍依赖Core；未验证更宽域或与P2/Morph叠加。
conclusions.P2: 两底座fixed positive F1、capture及连通性受益；fixed negative点改善的CI跨零，sc negative变差。fixed正F1交互显示Morph底座增益减弱，未建立协同。
conclusions.Morph: full相对NO_GEO的fixed P/N F1跨三个尺度均有利，新增几何的条件性贡献突出；直接DAPI的fixed negative改善有利。sc方向有权衡，full连通代价亦保留。
conclusions.simple_fusion: fixed相对BASE两项F1有明确场内改善；capture下降0.588858904pp超过冻结护栏，sc negative在commonQC反向。attention必要性与简化等价性均未建立。
conclusions.no_geo: 相对BASE四个F1点估计仅小幅改善，主尺度CI跨零且存在局部RNA损失；不能因sc点估计删掉有fixed收益的新增几何。
conclusions.global_record: 突出收益指具名比较中的增量；本轮没有刷新28方法固定P最高/固定N最低，历史B1仍为0.4084453551978994/0.0283230365850249。历史横比也不等于严格配对因果排名。
conclusions.owner_and_replication: 单Rep1/seed；空间CI是本片条件不确定性，非跨seed/样本重复或owner准确率。A1先验标签、历史full初态重建、容量变化和局部损失限制均保留。
conclusions.combinations: 仅fullMorph×P2四格已测；没有已验证的三模块联合方案。未自动追加A3、loss、扫参、新窗口或组合。
conclusions.default: 尚无消除双评价分歧与局部代价的统一默认赢家；保留当前默认方法。

assessment_policy.F1_instruction: 在评价时，将固定指标的F1和Scclassify F1同样作为评测指标，如果固定指标上有明显突出也需要注明
assessment_policy.comparator_instruction: 同时将需要与Base match进行比较的实验对照组中添加B0的指标；论文可能主要以B0为主要对照组
assessment_policy.current_assessment: Parallel fixed-label and scClassify positive/negative F1; highlight either profile standout and conflicts, with original populations. No post-hoc scalar winner score.
assessment_policy.paper_reference: B0 explicitly included for all BASE_MATCH-related contrasts; may serve as paper principal reference.
assessment_policy.mechanistic_control: Retain BASE_MATCH and A2 GT/SHUFFLED controlled contrasts; B0 has unmatched training initialization/history/order.
assessment_policy.frozen_gate: Original sc-primary/fixed-auxiliary software decisions are immutable historical calculations, not silently relabeled as dual-profile gates.
assessment_policy.evaluations: Reuse verified actual existing scores; no mask, expression matrix, annotation, reference model, NA rule or scientific thresholds changed.

legacy_scope: Old20 and pairwise Purity outputs stay at original paths; this version is current28. B0 is historical unmatched reference.
